result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but a few visual defects stand out: a nonsensical "-0%" discount badge on the second popular restaurant card, an inconsistent favorite (heart) button treatment between the two large cards, and a dish image in the first carousel card that appears mis-scaled/cropped against the card edge. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The second card in "Popular right now" (pizza) shows a discount badge reading "-0%", which is a meaningless/invalid promotion value and looks like a data or formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and validate the promo data source so only real discounts (e.g. "-20%") render a badge.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icon is rendered inconsistently: on the ramen card it sits directly on the photo with no backing shape, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular background. On the lighter/busy ramen photo the plain white outline heart is harder to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim/background container to the heart button on all restaurant cards so it has consistent styling and reliable contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" row, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail appears off-center and cropped by the card's bottom/right edge (the plate is cut off), unlike the other thumbnails where the dish is fully centered within the frame.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent object-fit/object-position (e.g. cover with center positioning) and correct source asset framing so dish images are centered and not unintentionally clipped inside the card.

issues.description: The ramen card repeats the same information twice: a "€0 delivery" badge overlaid on the image and "€0 delivery" again in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery message in only one place (either the image badge or the metadata row) to reduce redundancy and visual noise.
